verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows some derivative activity around the models: a Llama 8B distilled from R1 outputs (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B), downloadable weights in mixed FP8/FP4 precision that people run locally, and third-party access via OpenRouter. Nothing in the pack shows community fine-tunes or quantizations on public hubs, or any labeling of what is official. missing for 10: evidence of community replicas/fine-tunes/quantizations on public hubs (e.g. Hugging Face), clear official-vs-unofficial attribution, first-party docs on weights and derivatives.
